subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should deferred become a permanent public cron, Gateway, CLI, UI, hook, and Plugin SDK contract for yielded-parent handoff?
rationale: The runtime bug is real, but the new persisted status and third-party SDK exports require maintainer intent and an explicit compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve public deferred contract
options.body: Accept deferred as a stable handoff status and require full upgrade and exact-head end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Keep handoff internal
options.body: Fix parent reconciliation internally while preserving current public cron status values and exposing diagnostics separately.

options.title: Split runtime and contract
options.body: Land the core and Discord lifecycle repair separately from protocol, SDK, CLI, UI, and persistence expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve public deferred contract
recommendation.body: Accept deferred as a stable handoff status and require full upgrade and exact-head end-to-end proof before merge.
